$comment: Example .claude/skills-config.json. Copy to .claude/skills-config.json and edit, or let /install generate it from what it detects on disk. Two halves: (1) issueTracker + docs (consumed by draft-prd/slice-issues/sort-issues/troubleshoot/etc.), (2) verify + packs (the 2-D language x class verify map the resolver and verify workflows read). Resolution of a repo's verify commands: verify.byRepo.<name>.overrides -> verify.defaults[<language>] -> built-in fallback.

packs.$comment: Activation flags per pack. A pack supplies the verify defaults, commands, and hooks for a language. 'python-fastapi' is the one real pack shipped today; java/node/go are spec-only placeholders (see packs/PACK-SPEC.md). Activating a pack copies its hooks into .claude/hooks/ and wires them into settings.json.

verify.$comment: The 2-D language x class verify map. defaults[<language>] gives the command chain for a language; byRepo.<name> pins a repo's language+class and may override individual commands. Commands are shell strings run from the repo root. Empty string = that stage is a no-op for this language.

java.$comment: mvn or gradle, selected by the presence of a wrapper (mvnw / gradlew). Adjust to your build tool.

node.$comment: <pm> is resolved by lockfile: pnpm-lock.yaml -> pnpm, yarn.lock -> yarn, package-lock.json -> npm. Replace <pm> with the resolved manager (the installer writes the concrete one).

python.$comment: Genericized lint + test + coverage chain. Assumes a .venv at the repo root (see the python-fastapi pack's venv hook). Swap flake8/pytest for ruff/etc. if your project differs.

byRepo.$comment: Per-repo pinning + overrides. 'language' and 'class' pin what the resolver would otherwise infer. 'overrides' replaces individual command stages for THIS repo only; unspecified stages fall through to defaults[language].
